values.note: Same on the 2027 sheet as 2026. On-season (Apr 15-Oct 31): basic $15, electric 30A $27, 50A $29, family double site (electric) 30A $42, 50A $46. Off-season (Nov 1-Apr 14, sites 1-34, 98 and 99 only): basic $14, electric 30A $23, 50A $25, family $36/$40. Rates include sales tax.

values.note: 96 sites, 74 electric (park page); UseDirect sells 91 (22 basic, 41 electric 30A, 23 electric 50A, 5 family double sites) with listed vehicle lengths 38-65 ft. Every site takes a 23-ft rig.

sites.source: https://mostateparks.com/park/watkins-mill-state-park/camping ('Watkins Mill has 96 campsites, 74 with electric hookups'; 'Parking pads vary in length from 38 feet to 80 feet') + UseDirect facility 842 grid, read 2026-11-09

values.note: Showers, dump station and laundry closed November-March; in the off-season water is at the fill hydrant across from the dump station.

facilities.source: https://mostateparks.com/park/watkins-mill-state-park/camping ('Showers, the dump station and laundry are not available during the off-season (November-March)'; 'potable water is available from the fresh water fill hydrant across from the dump station') + campground map legend (restroom, showerhouse, laundry, vault toilet, dump station), read 2026-11-09

note: A paved trail links the campground to Williams Creek Lake; the sites are set back in woods. The campground gate closes at 9 p.m. in the on-season and 8 p.m. off-season. --Claude
summary: Campground closed Nov-Dec 2026 for construction (status written, reopens January 2027). 2027 sheet = 2026: basic $15/$14, electric 30A $27/$23, 50A $29/$25, family $42-46; 96 sites (91 on UseDirect) pads 38-80 ft, 50A. Not waterfront confirmed. Booking (manual) and season (manual) left.
flags: CLOSURE: 'Watkins Mill Campground Closed for November and December 2026' - 'The campground and campground road ... are closed for all of November and December 2026 due to a construction project.' Recorded as status temporarily_closed, reopens January 2027.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront): confirmed. The map and leaf-off imagery put every spur in woods; the nearest pads (the west spur's north end) are ~130 m from Williams Creek Lake through trees and ~50-70 m from a ~0.3 ha pond (a pond, no value).
Pin: 39.3915,-94.2545 sits inside the east loop, ~150 m from the centre of the three spurs - within tolerance, left.
